findings.title: Claim has lost its PersistentVolume
findings.cause: PersistentVolumeClaim data is Lost: it is marked as bound to PersistentVolume pvc-4c1d9a7e-2b6f-4e0a-9c3d-8f5a1b7e6d20, and there is no such PersistentVolume, so pods that mount it are not scheduled. The volume was deleted under the claim, or the claim was created from a copy of a bound claim, with its volumeName and pv.kubernetes.io/bind-completed annotation, in a cluster that does not have that volume

evidence.command: kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pvc-lost -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}{" "}{.spec.volumeName}{" "}{.metadata.annotations}'

evidence.detail: Bound claim has lost its PersistentVolume. Data on the volume is lost!

findings.fix: A Lost claim never binds again. If the data still exists in the storage backend, create PersistentVolume pvc-4c1d9a7e-2b6f-4e0a-9c3d-8f5a1b7e6d20 again for it, with a claimRef to this claim. Otherwise delete the claim and create it without spec.volumeName and without the pv.kubernetes.io annotations, so that a new volume is provisioned; when copying claims from another cluster or a backup, leave those fields out.
